questions.question: To what does Hosea 10 compare Israel?
options: A luxuriant vine that yields fruit, but for itself
A scattered flock of sheep without any shepherd at all
A barren and dry fig tree that bears no fruit at all
A withered and dying field parched under the hot sun
questions.answer: A luxuriant vine that yields fruit, but for itself

questions.question: What does Hosea 10 call the people to sow and reap?
options: Sow righteousness and reap steadfast love; seek the LORD
Offer up many sacrifices on each and every high place
Raise up a great army and strongly fortify all the cities
Gather up much wealth and store it away for the future
questions.answer: Sow righteousness and reap steadfast love; seek the LORD

questions.question: Hosea 10 says it is time to seek the LORD, that he may come and rain righteousness.
Sow for yourselves _____, reap steadfast love; break up your fallow ground.
Israel is a luxuriant _____ that yields its fruit.
